_comment: Accepted mismatch counts for metadata/check_release_consistency.py. A check fails when its count goes UP. Lower an entry when you fix something; never raise one to let a release through. `schema` is 0 because the 88 stale column lists it found were repaired when the check was written, and `corrections-resolve` is 0 because every identifier does resolve once the comparison is done right; `counts` and `corrections-pinned` are 0 from 2026-10-24: the 59 contradicted rows were refreshed (#3214, #3213) and all 92 unpinned corrections were placed in their release (#3216). The two withdrawal entries are the remaining October 2026 backlog.
